articles.title: Adam Back makes case for simpler security as Blockstream launches Bitcoin custody system
articles.summary: Blockstream’s new custody system, developed with Thales, uses dedicated hardware for transaction signing as Adam Back advocates for offline security to reduce cyber risks.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Adam Back makes case for simpler security as Blockstream launches Bitcoin custody system
articles.summaryTr: Blockstream’s new custody system, developed with Thales, uses dedicated hardware for transaction signing as Adam Back advocates for offline security to reduce cyber risks.
articles.articleText: Adam Back makes case for simpler security as Blockstream launches Bitcoin custody system Blockstream’s new custody system, developed with Thales, uses dedicated hardware for transaction signing as Adam Back advocates for offline security to reduce cyber risks. Adam Back’s Bitcoin infrastructure company Blockstream has launched a new institutional digital asset custody solution developed with French technology group Thales, as the cryptographer pushes for simpler, offline security systems to protect Bitcoin against increasingly sophisticated cyberattacks. The solution, announced Friday, combines Thales’ hardware security modules (HSMs) with Blockstream’s Secure Multi-Party Computation (Secure-MPC) technology, allowing institutions to authorize transactions while keeping sensitive cryptographic operations within dedicated security hardware, according to the company. Unlike conventional MPC implementations that may perform portions of the signing process outside dedicated security hardware, Blockstream said its architecture executes the entire signing protocol within the protected environment of Thales’ HSMs. Blockstream co-founder and CEO Adam Back, a pioneering cryptographer whose Hashcash system helped lay the groundwork for Bitcoin’s proof-of-work mechanism, told Cointelegraph that conventional MPC protocols are often too complex and require too much communication between devices to be practical for fully offline cold storage. “When people talk about MPC, they’re talking about some very esoteric and complicated protocols that are hard to secure and are very interactive. So you can’t really use them in a cold storage setting,” Back said. Related: Blockstream rejects ransom as Liquid hackers hold nearly 600 BTC Adam Back makes the case for simpler Bitcoin custody Back pointed to the Binance $6.3 billion hack as an example of the risks facing internet-connected custody infrastructure, arguing that keeping signing devices offline can help prevent unauthorized access. According to Binance’s investigation, attackers compromised employee devices and obtained credentials that allowed them to access the exchange’s wallet-signing infrastructure. If you connect equipment to the internet, even if it’s via firewalls and so on, there is risk that you can get unauthorized access. You can get hackers into the network, get hackers with access to logins they shouldn’t have and so on. He also said that AI could make existing security challenges more difficult to manage, particularly by helping attackers discover subtle flaws in complex MPC implementations. “The AIs can help attackers find small implementation errors and things like that, which may not be obvious,” he said. Asked whether the broader custody industry would adopt similar offline security models, Back said he hoped so, arguing that institutions should “adapt to the environment” by moving assets into cold storage to reduce exposure to potential AI-assisted attacks. “Complexity is the enemy of security. And going back to basics is the answer, you know, just cold-store it,” Back added. Magazine: NK hackers join memecoin trenches, xStocks adds Hong Kong equities: Asia Express

articles.summary: Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), Plastikkart ve Flap Kongre’nin bedelsiz sermaye artırımlarına onay verdi. İki şirketin toplam sermayesi 116,5 milyon TL’den 700 milyon TL’ye yükselecek.

articles.titleTr: SPK'dan iki şirkete bedelsiz sermaye artırımı onayı
articles.summaryTr: Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), Plastikkart ve Flap Kongre’nin bedelsiz sermaye artırımlarına onay verdi. İki şirketin toplam sermayesi 116,5 milyon TL’den 700 milyon TL’ye yükselecek.
articles.articleText: SPK'dan iki şirkete bedelsiz sermaye artırımı onayı - Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), Plastikkart ve Flap Kongre’nin bedelsiz sermaye artırımlarına onay verdi. - İki şirketin toplam sermayesi 116,5 milyon TL’den 700 milyon TL’ye yükselecek. SPK bülteninde yer alan karara göre Plastikkart Akıllı Kart İletişim Sistemleri'nin 22 milyon 750 bin TL olan mevcut sermayesi, 277 milyon 250 bin TL bedelsiz artırımla 300 milyon TL’ye çıkarılacak. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Flap Kongre Toplantı Hizmetleri'nin ise 93 milyon 750 bin TL olan sermayesi, 306 milyon 250 bin TL bedelsiz artırımla 400 milyon TL’ye yükselecek. Böylece iki şirketin sermaye artırımına konu toplam bedelsiz tutarı 583 milyon 500 bin TL olacak. Bedelsiz sermaye artırımı, şirketlerin iç kaynaklarını (yedek akçeler, geçmiş yıl kârları veya sermaye düzeltmesi olumlu farkları gibi) kullanarak sermayelerini artırmasıdır. Bu işlemde yatırımcılar yeni payları ücretsiz alır; hisse sayısı artarken yatırımcının şirketteki ortaklık oranı, diğer koşullar aynı kaldığı sürece değişmez. Hisse fiyatı ise sermaye artırımına bağlı olarak teorik biçimde düzeltilir.

articles.title: ABD'de hava ulaşımında kaos: Uçuşlar başladı ama kriz bitmedi
articles.summary: ABD'de radar ve haberleşme sistemlerinde yaşanan teknik sorun nedeniyle durdurulan uçuşlar yeniden başladı. 6 binden fazla uçuşun iptal edildiği, 8 binden fazla uçuşun geciktiği ülkede hava ulaşımının normale dönmesinin zaman alacağı bildirildi.

articles.titleTr: ABD'de hava ulaşımında kaos: Uçuşlar başladı ama kriz bitmedi
articles.summaryTr: ABD'de radar ve haberleşme sistemlerinde yaşanan teknik sorun nedeniyle durdurulan uçuşlar yeniden başladı. 6 binden fazla uçuşun iptal edildiği, 8 binden fazla uçuşun geciktiği ülkede hava ulaşımının normale dönmesinin zaman alacağı bildirildi.
articles.articleText: ABD'de hava ulaşımında kaos: Uçuşlar başladı ama kriz bitmedi - ABD'de radar ve haberleşme sistemlerinde yaşanan teknik sorun nedeniyle durdurulan uçuşlar yeniden başladı. - 6 binden fazla uçuşun iptal edildiği, 8 binden fazla uçuşun geciktiği ülkede hava ulaşımının normale dönmesinin zaman alacağı bildirildi. ABD genelinde hava trafik kontrol sistemlerinde yaşanan teknik sorun nedeniyle durdurulan uçuşlar yeniden başladı. ABD Ulaştırma Bakanı Sean Duffy, Türkiye saatiyle 04.15 itibarıyla hava sahasının yeniden açıldığını duyurdu. Dört saatten fazla süren kısıtlama nedeniyle binlerce uçuş iptal edilirken, hava ulaşımında normale dönüşün zaman alacağı belirtildi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Beyaz Saray'da düzenlenen basın toplantısında konuşan Duffy, radar ve haberleşme sistemlerinde yaşanan dengesizlikler nedeniyle tedbir amaçlı uçuşları durdurduklarını açıkladı. Sistemlerin tamamen devre dışı kalmadığını belirten Duffy, sorunun eski donanımlardan kaynaklandığını, Donald Trump döneminde yenilenen cihazlarda ise herhangi bir kesinti yaşanmadığını söyledi. Binlerce uçuş iptal edildi Hava trafik kontrol merkezlerinin yeniden faaliyete geçtiğini bildiren Duffy, uçuşların hemen normale dönmeyeceğini ve sürecin kademeli ilerleyeceğini ifade etti. Uçuş takip sitesi FlightAware'in verilerine göre, ülke genelinde 8 binden fazla uçuşta gecikme yaşanırken, 6 binden fazla uçuş iptal edildi. Siber saldırı bulgusuna rastlanmadı ABD İç Güvenlik Bakanı Markwayne Mullin ise kesintinin Microsoft ile bağlantılı olmadığını ve şu ana kadar herhangi bir siber saldırı bulgusuna rastlanmadığını açıkladı. Olayın mekanik bir sorundan kaynaklanmış gibi göründüğünü belirten Mullin, incelemelerin sürdüğünü ve siber saldırı ihtimalinin tamamen dışlanmadığını kaydetti. Mullin, süreç boyunca hiçbir uçuşun tehlikeye girmediğini ve alınan kararın tamamen tedbir amaçlı olduğunu vurguladı. Yeni sistemler için 50 milyar dolar talebi Duffy, yaşanan kesintinin ardından hava trafik kontrol altyapısının modernizasyonuna yönelik finansman ihtiyacına da dikkat çekti. Trump yönetiminin 12,5 milyar dolarlık finansmanla yeniden inşa sürecini başlattığını belirten Duffy, mevcut kaynakların yeterli olmadığını söyledi. Duffy, "Başkan Trump 30 milyar dolar talep etti, ancak ben 50 milyar dolar gerektiğini düşünüyorum" ifadelerini kullandı.

SPK, tasfiye edilen yatırım fonlarından elde edilen kazançların halka açık şirketler tarafından isteğe bağlı olarak iade edilmesine ilişkin esasları belirledi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İadelerin hisse fiyatını veya yatırımcı kararlarını etkileyebilecek nitelikte olması halinde özel durum açıklaması yapılacak. Kurulun duyurduğu ilkelere göre şirketler, söz konusu iade ödemelerini genel kurul toplantılarında ayrı bir gündem maddesiyle pay sahiplerinin bilgisine sunacak. Ödemelerin finansal tablolara nasıl yansıtılacağı ve dipnotlarda nasıl açıklanacağı ise Türkiye Muhasebe ve Finansal Raporlama Standartları çerçevesinde değerlendirilecek.

articles.title: Microsoft 'deeply sorry' for global outage as it reports broad recovery
articles.summary: Experts say the event is a "stark reminder" of how heavily the world relies on a small group of big tech providers.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Microsoft 'deeply sorry' for global outage as it reports broad recovery
articles.summaryTr: Experts say the event is a "stark reminder" of how heavily the world relies on a small group of big tech providers.
articles.articleText: Microsoft 'deeply sorry' for global outage as it reports broad recovery - Published Microsoft has said it is "deeply sorry" for the service outage to its products, including Outlook and Teams, which has caused disruption around the world. Services were broadly recovering by Friday afternoon, nearly 24 hours after issues began. Microsoft said it was making "encouraging progress", but added it does not know when services will fully recover. The outage hit more than 70 countries, disrupting everything from business operations to government services and personal users. More than 430 million people use the affected products worldwide. Microsoft said it was a technical issue introduced during a "network capacity upgrade" and not related to cyber or artificial intelligence agents. Experts said the event was a "stark reminder" of how heavily businesses and vital services rely on a small group of big tech providers. Users began reporting they were having trouble accessing Microsoft 365 products on Thursday. By Friday, the far-reaching issue was affecting institutions from the Japanese government and the Philippines Supreme Court to the Australian spy agency, and trains, hospitals and courts in North America. - Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost? - Published11 hours ago - Courts, spies and MPs: How the Microsoft outage has been felt around the world - Published12 hours ago In the UK, some parts of the NHS, including GPs and hospitals, were affected, as were some schools and police forces. UK cyber minister Liz Lloyd said the incident had "limited" impact on critical frontline services such as 999 calls, and there had been no disruption to the transport network. In Canada, however, the national rail network said passengers may not be able to receive email updates about their trips, and hospitals across the country also had issues with emails. In the US, staff members from the House of Representatives told Politico it had set back an entire day of legislative work as everything was on Microsoft's Outlook. Singapore's government acknowledged some of its systems had been impacted, and in India, the outage disrupted work for many on Friday. In Turkey, advisers and officials attending the COP31 climate summit in Antalya were left frustrated by being unable to access Outlook. The issues also affected smaller businesses and individuals. Peter Pentz, a winemaker in South Africa, said his entire business was basically brought to a "standstill". His winery's communication with exports was also brought to a standstill, he said, and "critical production work" was been halted as the Cape West Coast winery "relies on these systems for parts of our day-to-day operations". Georgia from Staffordshire in England said she was due to complete her first house purchase today after waiting eight months to get to this point - but the outage has delayed that. "The solicitor mentioned there may be a delay due to not being able to contact other agencies. "We're not the only one completing today, there are hundreds of houses and for them to ring everyone in time is unfeasible," Georgia said. 'Encouraging recovery signals' Microsoft first acknowledged users in the Americas were unable to access Exchange Online mailboxes at 17:54 GMT on Thursday, and shortly after warned the disruption was possibly affecting Microsoft 365 globally. While it launched an investigation and engineers began working to restore services, by 04:36 on Friday Microsoft was reporting only a "partial recovery" in some parts of the world. By 13:32, the tech giant said there were "broader improvements" in North America, "sustained improvements" across much of Europe and "encouraging recovery signals" in the Asia Pacific region. Microsoft said it restored services gradually due to the scale of the problem and to help ensure services remain stable once they are up and running again. "We are deeply sorry for the disruption this incident has caused our customers and partners," a Microsoft spokesperson said. "We know the trust they place in our services and take that responsibility extremely seriously." Microsoft said it has no "ETA" for when services will be fully recovered. A full post-incident report will be released once Microsoft has completed a review. Experts said while workers may have been happy to not have email access for the day, the incident showed the dependence many organisations have on these cloud-based services. "The global Microsoft outage is a stark reminder of how heavily we rely on a handful of big tech providers," said Rob Demain, chief executive of cybersecurity firm e2e-assure. Matt Saunders, field chief technology officer at tech consultancy Adaptavist, said it would be challenging to mitigate against a similar problem. "Classic IT disaster planning strategies suggest using a second service for resilience, but in practice, it's almost impossible for a business to function without tools such as Microsoft," he said. "In the wake of this outage, organisations must have a plan in place for how to work without such tools, for when incidents like this occur." articles.summary: Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), kredili sermaye piyasası işlemlerinde özkaynak oranının esnetilerek uygulanmasına yönelik tedbirin 31 Aralık 2026 seans sonuna kadar devam etmesine karar verdi.

articles.titleTr: SPK'dan borsada kredili işlem kararı: Süre yıl sonuna kadar uzatıldı
articles.summaryTr: Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), kredili sermaye piyasası işlemlerinde özkaynak oranının esnetilerek uygulanmasına yönelik tedbirin 31 Aralık 2026 seans sonuna kadar devam etmesine karar verdi.
articles.articleText: SPK'dan borsada kredili işlem kararı: Süre yıl sonuna kadar uzatıldı YAYIN TARİHİ, 14 Kasım 2026 00:13 GÜNCELLEME, 14 Kasım 2026 00:59 PAYLAŞ - Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), kredili sermaye piyasası işlemlerinde özkaynak oranının esnetilerek uygulanmasına yönelik tedbirin 31 Aralık 2026 seans sonuna kadar devam etmesine karar verdi. SPK, 27 Ekim 2026 tarihli kararıyla devreye aldığı ve 30 Ekim tarihli bülteninde duyurduğu uygulamanın süresini uzattı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Kurul, kararın sermaye piyasalarının güvenilir, şeffaf ve istikrarlı işleyişinin sağlanması ile yatırımcıların hak ve yararlarının korunması amacıyla alındığını bildirdi. Özkaynak oranı, yatırımcının kredili işlemlerde taşıdığı pozisyonun ne kadarının kendi varlıklarıyla karşılandığını gösteriyor. Oranın esnetilmesi, kredili işlem yapan yatırımcılar açısından teminat koşullarında kolaylık sağlıyor.

articles.title: SPK'dan 3 hisseye çifte yaptırım! 65 kişi ve 6 şirkete işlem yasağı
articles.summary: Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), EDATA, KARCL ve GRTHO pay piyasalarındaki işlemler nedeniyle kapsamlı yaptırım kararı aldı. Kurul, 65 kişi ve 6 şirkete 2 yıl süreyle işlem yasağı getirirken 76 kişi hakkında da suç duyurusunda bulunulmasına karar verdi.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: SPK'dan 3 hisseye çifte yaptırım! 65 kişi ve 6 şirkete işlem yasağı
articles.summaryTr: Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), EDATA, KARCL ve GRTHO pay piyasalarındaki işlemler nedeniyle kapsamlı yaptırım kararı aldı. Kurul, 65 kişi ve 6 şirkete 2 yıl süreyle işlem yasağı getirirken 76 kişi hakkında da suç duyurusunda bulunulmasına karar verdi.
articles.articleText: SPK'dan 3 hisseye çifte yaptırım! 65 kişi ve 6 şirkete işlem yasağı - Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu (SPK), EDATA, KARCL ve GRTHO pay piyasalarındaki işlemler nedeniyle kapsamlı yaptırım kararı aldı. - Kurul, 65 kişi ve 6 şirkete 2 yıl süreyle işlem yasağı getirirken 76 kişi hakkında da suç duyurusunda bulunulmasına karar verdi. SPK'nın incelemeleri sonucunda EDATA, KARCL ve GRTHO hisselerinde gerçekleştirilen işlemlerin piyasa dolandırıcılığı kapsamında değerlendirildiği belirtildi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Kurul, söz konusu işlemlerle bağlantılı olarak hem gerçek kişiler hem de şirketler hakkında yaptırım uyguladı. 65 kişi ve 6 şirkete 2 yıl işlem yasağı SPK kararına göre EDATA işlemleri nedeniyle 8, KARCL işlemleri nedeniyle 44, GRTHO işlemleri nedeniyle 24 kişi hakkında işlem yasağı kararı verildi. Birden fazla dosyada adı geçen kişiler bulunduğundan, toplam 76 kayda karşılık 65 farklı kişiye 2 yıl süreyle işlem yasağı getirildi. Karar kapsamında 6 şirkete de ilgili paylarda kendi nam ve hesaplarına gerçekleştirdikleri işlemlerle sınırlı olmak üzere 2 yıl işlem yasağı uygulandı. Bu şirketler A1 Capital Portföy Yönetimi, A1 Capital Yatırım Menkul Değerler, Pardus Portföy Yönetimi, Tera Girişim Sermayesi Yatırım Ortaklığı, Tera Portföy Yönetimi ve Tera Yatırım Bankası oldu. Etkin pişmanlık için 15 gün süre Kurul, hakkında suç duyurusu kararı alınan kişilerin Kanun'un 107/3'üncü maddesi kapsamında etkin pişmanlık hükümlerinden yararlanabileceğini bildirdi. Buna göre, bu hükümlerden yararlanmak isteyenlerin, 500 bin TL'den az olmamak üzere elde ettikleri veya elde edilmesine neden oldukları menfaatin iki katı tutarındaki parayı SPK kararından itibaren 15 gün içinde Hazine ve Maliye Bakanlığı'nın ilgili hesabına yatırmaları gerekiyor. Ödeme belgelerinin de aynı süre içinde SPK'ya iletilmesi şartı bulunuyor.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward gains market share as slower trading weighs on earnings
articles.summary: Payward’s adjusted EBITDA fell 66% year over year to $60 million, even as its share of global spot trading nearly doubled and fee-based services expanded.

articles.titleTr: Kraken parent Payward gains market share as slower trading weighs on earnings
articles.summaryTr: Payward’s adjusted EBITDA fell 66% year over year to $60 million, even as its share of global spot trading nearly doubled and fee-based services expanded.
articles.articleText: Kraken parent Payward gains market share as slower trading weighs on earnings Payward’s adjusted EBITDA fell 66% year over year to $60 million, even as its share of global spot trading nearly doubled and fee-based services expanded. Kraken’s parent company Payward nearly doubled its share of global crypto spot trading to 6.5% in September from 3.3% a year earlier, even as weaker trading activity weighed on its earnings. The market-share gain means Payward captured a larger portion of spot trading relative to competitors, rather than an increase in trading activity across its platforms. The company handled $353 billion in transactions in the third quarter, down 30% from a year earlier, according to financial results released Friday. The two figures measure different things. The market share tracks its portion of global spot trading across its platforms in September, compared with a year earlier, while Payward’s quarterly transaction volume includes activity across multiple products, including spot, margin, equities, payments and certain derivatives. Adjusted EBITDA fell to $60 million from the $178.6 million reported a year earlier. Total platform margin fell 12% to $487 million. Payward introduced that measure this quarter to replace adjusted revenue, adding a deduction for staking rewards paid to customers. Acquisitions expand Payward beyond spot trading Payward has spent the past two years expanding beyond its core cryptocurrency exchange business through acquisitions in derivatives, proprietary trading, tokenized assets and payments. The strategy aims to diversify revenue beyond transaction fees, which fluctuate with market activity. Its purchases include futures broker NinjaTrader and proprietary trading firm Breakout in 2025, followed by the acquisition of US-regulated derivatives platform Bitnomial in May 2026. The company also expanded into stablecoin payments with its purchase of Reap in July. Those businesses contributed to a broader mix of trading and service-based activity in the third quarter. The number of derivatives contracts on which Payward charges a per-contract fee rose 84% to 66 million. Margin from subscriptions, trader evaluations and other paid services rose 59% to $125 million. Breakout, which charges traders for evaluations that can qualify them for funded trading accounts, was included for the full quarter after joining in September 2025. The July purchase of Reap added a stablecoin payments and card-issuing business. The company did not quantify either acquisition’s contribution to the quarter. Related: Kraken parent Payward acquires Magic Labs’ wallet business Earnings recover from second-quarter lows Results improved from the second quarter despite remaining below year-earlier levels. Total transaction volume rose 22%, while total platform margin increased 12% to $487 million from $436 million. The improvement was not driven by trading alone. Margin earned from assets customers hold on Payward’s platforms, including staking-related services, rose 26% to $128 million. That accounted for roughly half of the $51 million quarterly increase in total platform margin. Adjusted EBITDA climbed to $60 million from $23 million, while its margin relative to total platform margin rose to 12% from 5%. Compared with a year earlier, however, adjusted EBITDA was down 66%, underscoring the pressure on profitability despite a growing contribution from services less directly tied to trading activity. Asset- and access-based services accounted for 52% of total platform margin, up from 46% a year earlier. That shift could matter for an eventual public listing. Payward confidentially filed for a US IPO in November 2025 but paused its plans in March as market conditions weakened. articles.articleTextTr: Kraken parent Payward gains market share as slower trading weighs on earnings Payward’s adjusted EBITDA fell 66% year over year to $60 million, even as its share of global spot trading nearly doubled and fee-based services expanded. Kraken’s parent company Payward nearly doubled its share of global crypto spot trading to 6.5% in September from 3.3% a year earlier, even as weaker trading activity weighed on its earnings. The market-share gain means Payward captured a larger portion of spot trading relative to competitors, rather than an increase in trading activity across its platforms. The company handled $353 billion in transactions in the third quarter, down 30% from a year earlier, according to financial results released Friday. The two figures measure different things. The market share tracks its portion of global spot trading across its platforms in September, compared with a year earlier, while Payward’s quarterly transaction volume includes activity across multiple products, including spot, margin, equities, payments and certain derivatives. Adjusted EBITDA fell to $60 million from the $178.6 million reported a year earlier. Total platform margin fell 12% to $487 million. Payward introduced that measure this quarter to replace adjusted revenue, adding a deduction for staking rewards paid to customers. Acquisitions expand Payward beyond spot trading Payward has spent the past two years expanding beyond its core cryptocurrency exchange business through acquisitions in derivatives, proprietary trading, tokenized assets and payments. The strategy aims to diversify revenue beyond transaction fees, which fluctuate with market activity. Its purchases include futures broker NinjaTrader and proprietary trading firm Breakout in 2025, followed by the acquisition of US-regulated derivatives platform Bitnomial in May 2026. The company also expanded into stablecoin payments with its purchase of Reap in July. Those businesses contributed to a broader mix of trading and service-based activity in the third quarter. The number of derivatives contracts on which Payward charges a per-contract fee rose 84% to 66 million. Margin from subscriptions, trader evaluations and other paid services rose 59% to $125 million. Breakout, which charges traders for evaluations that can qualify them for funded trading accounts, was included for the full quarter after joining in September 2025. The July purchase of Reap added a stablecoin payments and card-issuing business. The company did not quantify either acquisition’s contribution to the quarter. Related: Kraken parent Payward acquires Magic Labs’ wallet business Earnings recover from second-quarter lows Results improved from the second quarter despite remaining below year-earlier levels. Total transaction volume rose 22%, while total platform margin increased 12% to $487 million from $436 million. The improvement was not driven by trading alone. Margin earned from assets customers hold on Payward’s platforms, including staking-related services, rose 26% to $128 million. That accounted for roughly half of the $51 million quarterly increase in total platform margin. Adjusted EBITDA climbed to $60 million from $23 million, while its margin relative to total platform margin rose to 12% from 5%. Compared with a year earlier, however, adjusted EBITDA was down 66%, underscoring the pressure on profitability despite a growing contribution from services less directly tied to trading activity. Asset- and access-based services accounted for 52% of total platform margin, up from 46% a year earlier. That shift could matter for an eventual public listing. articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Sues Louisiana After State Court Blocks CFTC-Regulated Exchanges
articles.articleText: Release Number 9326-26 CFTC Sues Louisiana After State Court Blocks CFTC-Regulated Exchanges November 13, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it filed a lawsuit against Louisiana to block the state from prohibiting the offering of event contracts by CFTC-regulated designated contract markets, futures commission merchants, and derivatives clearing organizations. Louisiana obtained a state court order Thursday shutting down the operation of more than 30 companies in the state connected to the trading of CFTC-regulated derivatives products without giving the defendants notice or an opportunity to be heard. “Event contracts have traded openly in Louisiana for years, in compliance with the Commodity Exchange Act and CFTC regulations,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “The state’s eleventh-hour ‘emergency’ lawsuit seeking to shut down the entire prediction market industry is naked lawfare and a cynical political stunt. The Commission’s lawsuit seeks to maintain the status quo while the federal courts decide this issue in an orderly manner.” Louisiana is the 12th state the CFTC has sued to defend its exclusive jurisdiction over derivatives markets as granted by Congress under the Commodity Exchange Act. The CFTC has also submitted amicus briefs in four federal Courts of Appeal and one state Supreme Court. -CFTC-

articles.title: US regulators move ahead on crypto trust charters as Senate scrutiny grows
articles.summary: Coinbase’s trust company received final clearance as lawmakers seek records on crypto firms’ compliance and potential conflicts of interest.

articles.titleTr: US regulators move ahead on crypto trust charters as Senate scrutiny grows
articles.summaryTr: Coinbase’s trust company received final clearance as lawmakers seek records on crypto firms’ compliance and potential conflicts of interest.
articles.articleText: US regulators move ahead on crypto trust charters as Senate scrutiny grows Coinbase’s trust company received final clearance as lawmakers seek records on crypto firms’ compliance and potential conflicts of interest. Federal regulators are opening more avenues for crypto companies to operate under US rules, while congressional investigators are asking to see the records behind those decisions. Lawmakers want to know how regulators justified new trust charters, how crypto companies handled compliance and what dealings they had with people tied to President Donald Trump’s administration. On Nov. 9, Coinbase announced that its national trust company had received final approval to open. The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency granted preliminary conditional approval in April. The company said the charter gives its custody business a consistent federal framework. Lawmakers had been questioning how federal regulators were using their existing authority to expand crypto companies’ reach. In a May 18 letter to the OCC, Sen. Elizabeth Warren challenged at least nine crypto trust-charter approvals, including Coinbase’s earlier conditional approval. She asked for the applications, the legal analyses behind the approvals and any related communications between OCC officials and the White House or Trump family. Four days before Coinbase’s announcement, Sen. Richard Blumenthal renewed demands for records from Binance, Tether and two Trump-linked ventures. He gave them until Jan. 4, 2027, to turn over the requested records voluntarily and warned that his subcommittee could take other steps to obtain them. To read the full report sign up for the Daybreak Newsletter.

articles.articleText: Borsada 419 milyon TL'lik özel emir trafiği! THYAO ve ISCTR'de dikkat çeken hareket - BIST 100 endeksinin yüzde 0,27 yükselişle 11.842,82 puandan kapandığı 13 Kasım'da 8 hisse senedinde özel emirle işlem yapıldı. - En yüksek işlem hacmi 176,9 milyon TL ile THYAO'da, en yüksek lot miktarı ise 10 milyon lotla ISCTR'de gerçekleşti. BIST 100'ün yüzde 0,27 yükseldiği 13 Kasım'da 8 hissede toplam 419,5 milyon TL'lik özel emir işlemi gerçekleştirildi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İşlem hacminde THYAO, lot miktarında ise ISCTR ilk sırada yer aldı. 13 Kasım'da özel emirle işlem yapılan hisseler Özel emir işlemi nedir? Özel emir, hisse senedinde alıcı ve satıcının karşılıklı anlaşmasıyla, borsada o anda oluşan fiyatlardan bağımsız olarak belirlenen fiyat üzerinden gerçekleştirilen işlemdir. Bu emirlerde işlem yapılacak karşı yatırım kuruluşu, nominal tutar, fiyat, valör ve sermaye piyasası aracı belirtilir. Özel emir yalnızca işlemin karşı tarafı olarak belirlenen yatırım kuruluşu tarafından görüntülenebilir. Bazı yüksek tutarlı işlemlerin ardından alıcı ve satıcı taraflar pay alım satım bildirimlerini Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'nda (KAP) yayımlayabilir. Bildirim yapılmadığı durumlarda işlemin hangi yatırımcılar tarafından gerçekleştirildiğinin bilinmesi mümkün değildir.

articles.title: Metaplanet swings to $170M loss as Bitcoin sale hits earnings
articles.summary: Bitcoin sales, valuation losses and rising borrowing costs weighed on the Japanese company’s earnings despite higher revenue and operating profit.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Metaplanet swings to $170M loss as Bitcoin sale hits earnings
articles.summaryTr: Bitcoin sales, valuation losses and rising borrowing costs weighed on the Japanese company’s earnings despite higher revenue and operating profit.
articles.articleText: Metaplanet swings to $170M loss as Bitcoin sale hits earnings Bitcoin sales, valuation losses and rising borrowing costs weighed on the Japanese company’s earnings despite higher revenue and operating profit. Metaplanet swung to a $170 million net loss in the first nine months of 2026, hit by a decline in the value of its Bitcoin holdings and a loss on the sale of 10,000 coins to demonstrate its ability to raise cash. The Japanese company, the world’s second-largest publicly traded corporate Bitcoin (BTC) holder, posted a net loss of 27.16 billion yen (about $170 million), compared with a profit of 13.53 billion yen ($84.6 million) in the same period last year. A 19.17 billion yen ($119.8 million) loss on the Bitcoin sale and an 8.04 billion yen ($50.3 million) loss from a decline in the value of its Bitcoin holdings outweighed gains in the operating business. Over the quarter, Metaplanet sold the 10,000 BTC for 124.7 billion yen and temporarily held the proceeds in cash, stablecoins and other liquid assets. It then spent 149.9 billion yen to buy 11,000 BTC, paying 9.3% more per coin on average. The company said the sale was meant to show rating agencies and bond investors that it could turn its Bitcoin into cash to meet financing obligations. At the end of September, holdings rose by a net 1,000 coins to 44,000 BTC. Top 10 largest Bitcoin treasury companies. Source: BitcoinTreasuries.NET Metaplanet borrowed against its Bitcoin holdings during the quarter, increasing the amount it owed under the credit line to $649.5 million at the end of September from $414 million at the end of June. The company said it funded Bitcoin purchases from the second quarter onward with money borrowed under the credit line, proceeds from bond sales and the exercise of stock acquisition rights, and revenue from its Bitcoin options business. Metaplanet’s interest expense rose 56% from the previous quarter to 1.36 billion yen ($8.5 million). Short-term borrowings and bonds payable totaled 110.5 billion yen ($691 million) at the end of September. For the nine months through September, revenue rose 30.5% to 5.9 billion yen ($36.9 million), while operating profit increased 26.5% to 3.48 billion yen ($21.8 million). The company cut its full-year revenue forecast to 6.5 billion yen ($40.6 million) from 16 billion yen ($100 million). Related: Metaplanet to take 93.7% stake in Super League through 2,100 BTC deal Bitcoin treasury companies face pressure from falling prices, index removals Metaplanet’s earnings come as Bitcoin treasury companies face mounting pressure from incoming stock index removals and falling Bitcoin prices. Index provider MSCI confirmed Wednesday that Strategy, Metaplanet and Upexi would be removed from its equity indexes at the Nov. 30 market close, potentially prompting funds that track those benchmarks to sell the shares. JPMorgan previously estimated that Strategy’s removal could result in roughly $2.8 billion in selling pressure from MSCI-linked funds. Bitcoin fell below $70,000 on Friday and was trading around $68,600 as of 4:51 p.m. UTC, down about 9% over the previous week, according to CoinGecko data. articles.title: CFTC Files Lawsuit Against Arkansas as the Agency Defends its Federal Jurisdiction Over Prediction Markets
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Files Lawsuit Against Arkansas as the Agency Defends its Federal Jurisdiction Over Prediction Markets
articles.articleText: Release Number 9325-26 CFTC Files Lawsuit Against Arkansas as the Agency Defends its Federal Jurisdiction Over Prediction Markets November 13, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced that it has filed a lawsuit against Arkansas to block the state’s attempts to halt event-contract trading and impose up to hundreds of millions of dollars in civil penalties on CFTC-registered exchanges. Arkansas is bringing a civil enforcement against Kalshi in state court, a CFTC-designated contract market. Arkansas’s efforts to obstruct the functions of CFTC-registered exchanges operating lawfully under the Commodity Exchange Act are preempted by federal law. “As prediction markets continue to prove their value in being useful for risk management and providing the public with valuable information about the future, Arkansas seeks to shut down event contracts ranging from sports and politics to other important world events,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “The CFTC will continue to defend its sole jurisdiction over these federally regulated markets as granted by Congress under the Commodity Exchange Act, and the Commission will not let state interference thwart its regulatory efforts and destroy federally regulated markets.” Arkansas is the 11th state the CFTC has sued to vindicate federal sovereign interests. The CFTC has also submitted amicus briefs in four federal Courts of Appeal and one state Supreme Court. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
articles.articleText: Release Number 9324-26 CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers November 09, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced eight orders filing and settling charges against Michael Talento, Anthony Tyler Williams, Quillan Roberto Black, Christopher Williams, Michael Levi Peters, Jordan Taylor Morgan, Lewis Matthew Neal, and Tyler Evan MacKechnie for acting as unregistered associated persons of unregistered foreign introducing brokers. According to the orders, the introducing brokers engaged in the solicitation of orders for off-exchange leveraged or margined retail foreign currency and retail commodities transactions with U.S. customers who were not eligible contract participants. The respondents solicited those customers without registering as associated persons of the introducing brokers, as required. Under the orders, the respondents must cease and desist from engaging in their illegal conduct. They also are barred for two years from registering with the Commission in any capacity or acting as a principal, agent, or employee of any CFTC registrant. Each order also recognizes the penalty the respondent owes in a related Securities and Exchange Commission proceeding. These orders relate to a prior Commission order sanctioning Netrios LP Ltd. and Red Acre Ltd. for facilitating illegal off-exchange commodity transactions with U.S. customers. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9263-26] The SEC has filed and settled charges against the respondents based on the same underlying conduct. The CFTC thanks the SEC for its assistance. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
articles.articleText: Release Number 9323-26 CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today issued an interpretation (“Interpretation”) of the requirement that designated contract markets (“DCMs”) provide competitive, open, fair, and impartial access to their members and persons with trading privileges under Commission Regulation 38.151(b) (“Impartial Access Requirements”). “Derivatives markets must operate on a uniform basis at a national scale in order to achieve the purposes set out in the Commodity Exchange Act,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Geographic access restrictions are inconsistent with those purposes and the Act’s impartial access requirements.” DCMs must cease domestic geographic restrictions that violate the Impartial Access Requirements within 30 days, or else submit to the Division of Market Oversight (“Division”) an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. Further, within 30 days, DCMs should ensure that intermediaries accessing their markets are not impeding and are complying with the DCM’s Impartial Access Requirements, or else submit to the Division an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. The Commission will consider the facts and circumstances of any particular case in connection with potential Commission action. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
articles.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
articles.articleText: Release Number 9320-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas entered a default judgment against defendants Walter Dunning Larrick III and Cambridge Financial Advisors LLC for their participation in a commodities fraud scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented they would use participant funds to trade futures and options, including those involving natural gas, oil, and gold; made material misrepresentations and omissions about the profitability of commodity trading with them; and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying Larrick’s personal expenses, and sending funds to offshore accounts in Costa Rica. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,767,625 civil monetary penalty and $3,255,875 in restitution. It also permanently enjoined them from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposed permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
articles.articleText: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-

news.articleText: Okullarda yeni dönem: MEB'den sınavlarda yapay zeka adımı - Milli Eğitim Bakanlığı (MEB), ölçme ve değerlendirme yönetmeliğinde değişikliğe gitti. Yeni düzenlemeyle sınav sorularının hazırlanması ve değerlendirilmesinde yapay zeka araçları kullanılabilecek. Ortak yazılı sınavlara ilişkin kurallar da yeniden belirlendi. Milli Eğitim Bakanlığı (MEB), Ölçme ve Değerlendirme Yönetmeliği'nde değişikliğe gitti. Yeni düzenlemeyle okul öncesi ve ilkokullarda sınav yapılamayacağı hükme bağlanırken, ortak yazılı sınavların uygulanmasına ilişkin esaslar yeniden belirlendi. Soru hazırlama ve değerlendirme süreçlerinde yapay zeka kullanımının da önü açıldı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Resmi Gazete'de yayımlanan yönetmelik değişikliğiyle, MEB'e bağlı resmi ve özel eğitim kurumlarında yürütülen ölçme ve değerlendirme faaliyetleri, merkezi sistem sınavları ile ulusal ve uluslararası izleme araştırmalarına ilişkin yeni kurallar belirlendi. Düzenlemeye göre ölçme ve değerlendirme faaliyetleri, öğrencilerin öğrenme süreçlerindeki gelişimlerinin izlenmesi, ihtiyaçlarının belirlenmesi ve öğretim süreçlerinin geliştirilmesi amacıyla yürütülecek. İlkokullarda sınav yapılmayacak Yönetmelikte öne çıkan düzenlemelerden biri okul öncesi ve ilkokullara ilişkin oldu. Bu eğitim kademelerinde herhangi bir ad altında sınav yapılamayacak. Öğrencilerin bilişsel, fiziksel, sosyal ve duygusal gelişimleri eğitim süreci boyunca takip edilecek ve desteklenecek. Öğrenci başarısı ise öğretim programındaki öğrenme çıktıları ve kazanımlar esas alınarak yapılan ölçme ve değerlendirme uygulamalarından elde edilen sonuçlara göre belirlenecek. Sınavlarda yapay zeka dönemi Yeni yönetmelikle eğitimde dijitalleşmeye yönelik de önemli bir adım atıldı. Ölçme ve değerlendirme faaliyetleri, Bakanlığın uygun gördüğü dijital sistemler ve araçlarla kısmen veya tamamen elektronik ortamda yürütülebilecek. news.titleTr: Microsoft'ta küresel kesinti: 7 soruda Outlook ve Teams krizinin perde arkası
news.summaryTr: Microsoft'un Outlook ve Teams başta olmak üzere birçok hizmetinde yaşanan küresel kesinti, 70'ten fazla ülkede iş hayatını ve kamu hizmetlerini aksattı. Teknoloji devi kesinti nedeniyle özür dilerken, hizmetlerin tamamen ne zaman normale döneceğine ilişkin tarih veremedi.
news.articleText: Microsoft'ta küresel kesinti: 7 soruda Outlook ve Teams krizinin perde arkası - Microsoft'un Outlook ve Teams başta olmak üzere birçok hizmetinde yaşanan küresel kesinti, 70'ten fazla ülkede iş hayatını ve kamu hizmetlerini aksattı. Teknoloji devi kesinti nedeniyle özür dilerken, hizmetlerin tamamen ne zaman normale döneceğine ilişkin tarih veremedi. Dünyanın en büyük teknoloji şirketlerinden Microsoft'un bulut tabanlı hizmetlerinde yaşanan kesinti, küresel çapta milyonlarca kullanıcıyı etkiledi. Hastanelerden mahkemelere, hükümet kurumlarından küçük işletmelere kadar birçok kuruluşun faaliyetleri etkilendi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Microsoft, sorunların başlamasından yaklaşık 24 saat sonra hizmetlerde toparlanma görüldüğünü açıklarken, kesintinin nedenine ilişkin de bilgi verdi. Yaşanan kriz, dünyanın büyük teknoloji şirketlerine olan bağımlılığını yeniden gündeme taşıdı. Microsoft'ta küresel kesinti neden yaşandı? Microsoft, kesintinin bir ağ kapasitesi yükseltmesi sırasında ortaya çıkan teknik sorundan kaynaklandığını açıkladı. Şirket, yaşanan aksaklığın bir siber saldırıdan veya yapay zeka ajanlarıyla bağlantılı bir sorundan kaynaklanmadığını belirtti. Microsoft, perşembe günü ilk olarak Amerika kıtasındaki kullanıcıların Exchange Online posta kutularına erişim sorunları yaşadığını duyurdu. Kısa süre sonra ise sorunun Microsoft 365 hizmetlerini küresel çapta etkileyebileceği uyarısında bulundu. Hangi Microsoft hizmetleri etkilendi? Kesintiden başta Outlook ve Teams olmak üzere Microsoft 365 bünyesindeki çeşitli hizmetler etkilendi. Kullanıcılar e-posta gönderme ve alma, çevrim içi toplantılara katılma ve kurumsal iletişim sistemlerine erişme konusunda sorunlar yaşadı. Dünya genelinde 430 milyondan fazla kişinin kesintiden etkilenen Microsoft ürünlerini kullandığı belirtilirken, bu kullanıcıların ne kadarının doğrudan erişim sorunu yaşadığına ilişkin net bir sayı paylaşılmadı. Kesinti hangi ülkelerde ve sektörlerde etkili oldu? Microsoft'un yaşadığı teknik sorun 70'ten fazla ülkede hissedildi. Kesinti yalnızca bireysel kullanıcıları değil, kamu kurumlarını ve kritik hizmetleri de etkiledi. Japonya hükümeti, Filipinler Yüksek Mahkemesi ve Avustralya istihbarat teşkilatı kesintiden etkilenen kurumlar arasında yer aldı. İngiltere'de bazı hastaneler, aile hekimleri, okullar ve polis teşkilatları da erişim sorunları yaşadı. Kanada'da ulusal demiryolu ağı, yolcuların seyahatlerine ilişkin e-posta bildirimlerini alamayabileceğini duyurdu. ABD'de ise Temsilciler Meclisi çalışanları, Outlook'a erişilememesi nedeniyle yasama çalışmalarının bir gün boyunca aksadığını bildirdi. Singapur ve Hindistan'da da kamu hizmetleri ve iş dünyasında çeşitli aksaklıklar meydana geldi. Outlook ve Teams ne zaman tamamen düzelecek? Microsoft, kesintinin başlamasının ardından mühendislerinin hizmetleri yeniden devreye almak için çalıştığını açıkladı. Cuma sabahı dünyanın bazı bölgelerinde kısmi iyileşme sağlandığını bildiren şirket, öğleden sonra Kuzey Amerika'da daha geniş kapsamlı toparlanma, Avrupa'nın büyük bölümünde kalıcı iyileşme ve Asya Pasifik bölgesinde olumlu gelişmeler kaydedildiğini duyurdu. Microsoft, sorunun büyüklüğü nedeniyle hizmetleri kademeli olarak yeniden devreye aldığını ve sistemlerin istikrarlı şekilde çalışmasını sağlamayı hedeflediğini belirtti. Ancak şirket, hizmetlerin tamamen normale dönmesi için henüz bir tarih veremedi. Microsoft kesintiyle ilgili ne açıklama yaptı? Microsoft, küresel kesintinin müşterileri ve iş ortakları üzerinde yarattığı aksaklık nedeniyle özür diledi. Şirket sözcüsü, "Bu olayın müşterilerimiz ve ortaklarımız için yarattığı aksaklıktan dolayı derin üzüntü duyuyoruz. Hizmetlerimize duydukları güvenin farkındayız ve bu sorumluluğu son derece ciddiye alıyoruz" ifadelerini kullandı. Microsoft'tan yapılan son açıklamada bireysel kullanıcılara yönelik hizmetlerinin tamamen normale döndüğünü, Microsoft 365 kurumsal hizmetlerinde ise kısmi toparlanma sağlandığını açıkladı. Teknoloji devi, kurumsal hizmetlerdeki sorunun tamamen çözülüp çözülmediğini değerlendirmeden önce kesinti sırasında biriken e-postaların iletim sürecini takip ettiğini bildirdi. Microsoft, hizmet durumu sayfasında yaptığı açıklamada, kesintinin etkisinin büyüklüğü nedeniyle ek önleyici tedbirlere ihtiyaç olup olmadığını belirlemek amacıyla sistemleri uzun süre izlemeye devam edeceğini belirtti. Uzmanlar Microsoft krizini nasıl değerlendiriyor? Uzmanlara göre küresel kesinti, işletmelerin ve kritik kamu hizmetlerinin sınırlı sayıdaki büyük teknoloji sağlayıcısına ne kadar bağımlı olduğunu bir kez daha ortaya koydu. Siber güvenlik şirketi e2e-assure'un CEO'su Rob Demain, Microsoft'un yaşadığı kesintinin birkaç büyük teknoloji sağlayıcısına olan bağımlılığın çarpıcı bir hatırlatıcısı olduğunu söyledi. Teknoloji danışmanlık şirketi Adaptavist'in saha baş teknoloji sorumlusu Matt Saunders ise geleneksel bilişim teknolojileri kriz planlarının alternatif hizmet sağlayıcılarının kullanılmasını önerdiğini, ancak günümüzde işletmelerin Microsoft gibi araçlar olmadan faaliyet göstermesinin son derece zor olduğunu belirtti. Saunders, yaşanan kesintinin ardından kuruluşların benzer durumlarda temel dijital araçlara erişemeden faaliyetlerini nasıl sürdüreceklerine ilişkin planlar hazırlamaları gerektiğini vurguladı.

Kesinti yalnızca bireysel kullanıcıları değil, kamu kurumlarını ve kritik hizmetleri de etkiledi. Japonya hükümeti, Filipinler Yüksek Mahkemesi ve Avustralya istihbarat teşkilatı kesintiden etkilenen kurumlar arasında yer aldı. İngiltere'de bazı hastaneler, aile hekimleri, okullar ve polis teşkilatları da erişim sorunları yaşadı. Kanada'da ulusal demiryolu ağı, yolcuların seyahatlerine ilişkin e-posta bildirimlerini alamayabileceğini duyurdu. ABD'de ise Temsilciler Meclisi çalışanları, Outlook'a erişilememesi nedeniyle yasama çalışmalarının bir gün boyunca aksadığını bildirdi. Singapur ve Hindistan'da da kamu hizmetleri ve iş dünyasında çeşitli aksaklıklar meydana geldi. Outlook ve Teams ne zaman tamamen düzelecek? Microsoft, kesintinin başlamasının ardından mühendislerinin hizmetleri yeniden devreye almak için çalıştığını açıkladı. Cuma sabahı dünyanın bazı bölgelerinde kısmi iyileşme sağlandığını bildiren şirket, öğleden sonra Kuzey Amerika'da daha geniş kapsamlı toparlanma, Avrupa'nın büyük bölümünde kalıcı iyileşme ve Asya Pasifik bölgesinde olumlu gelişmeler kaydedildiğini duyurdu. Microsoft, sorunun büyüklüğü nedeniyle hizmetleri kademeli olarak yeniden devreye aldığını ve sistemlerin istikrarlı şekilde çalışmasını sağlamayı hedeflediğini belirtti. Ancak şirket, hizmetlerin tamamen normale dönmesi için henüz bir tarih veremedi. Microsoft kesintiyle ilgili ne açıklama yaptı? Microsoft, küresel kesintinin müşterileri ve iş ortakları üzerinde yarattığı aksaklık nedeniyle özür diledi. Şirket sözcüsü, "Bu olayın müşterilerimiz ve ortaklarımız için yarattığı aksaklıktan dolayı derin üzüntü duyuyoruz. Hizmetlerimize duydukları güvenin farkındayız ve bu sorumluluğu son derece ciddiye alıyoruz" ifadelerini kullandı. Microsoft'tan yapılan son açıklamada bireysel kullanıcılara yönelik hizmetlerinin tamamen normale döndüğünü, Microsoft 365 kurumsal hizmetlerinde ise kısmi toparlanma sağlandığını açıkladı. Teknoloji devi, kurumsal hizmetlerdeki sorunun tamamen çözülüp çözülmediğini değerlendirmeden önce kesinti sırasında biriken e-postaların iletim sürecini takip ettiğini bildirdi. Microsoft, hizmet durumu sayfasında yaptığı açıklamada, kesintinin etkisinin büyüklüğü nedeniyle ek önleyici tedbirlere ihtiyaç olup olmadığını belirlemek amacıyla sistemleri uzun süre izlemeye devam edeceğini belirtti. Uzmanlar Microsoft krizini nasıl değerlendiriyor? Uzmanlara göre küresel kesinti, işletmelerin ve kritik kamu hizmetlerinin sınırlı sayıdaki büyük teknoloji sağlayıcısına ne kadar bağımlı olduğunu bir kez daha ortaya koydu. Siber güvenlik şirketi e2e-assure'un CEO'su Rob Demain, Microsoft'un yaşadığı kesintinin birkaç büyük teknoloji sağlayıcısına olan bağımlılığın çarpıcı bir hatırlatıcısı olduğunu söyledi. Teknoloji danışmanlık şirketi Adaptavist'in saha baş teknoloji sorumlusu Matt Saunders ise geleneksel bilişim teknolojileri kriz planlarının alternatif hizmet sağlayıcılarının kullanılmasını önerdiğini, ancak günümüzde işletmelerin Microsoft gibi araçlar olmadan faaliyet göstermesinin son derece zor olduğunu belirtti. Saunders, yaşanan kesintinin ardından kuruluşların benzer durumlarda temel dijital araçlara erişemeden faaliyetlerini nasıl sürdüreceklerine ilişkin planlar hazırlamaları gerektiğini vurguladı.

news.title: Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says
news.summary: Trump will discuss the "reduction of nuclear weapons" during the unprecedented talks, a spokeswoman says.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says
news.summaryTr: Trump will discuss the "reduction of nuclear weapons" during the unprecedented talks, a spokeswoman says.
news.articleText: Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says - Published Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping are planning to meet on the sidelines of a summit in China next week, the White House has said. The historic meeting between the leaders of the US, Russia and China will take place as Trump attends the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) summit in the southern city of Shenzhen, spokeswoman Olivia Wales told reporters. "The president has made it clear that, among other topics, he will discuss the reduction of nuclear weapons in the world, whose proliferation President Trump believes is very dangerous," she said. It is understood Iran may also be discussed during the meeting of the world's biggest nuclear powers, but not Ukraine. Moscow and Beijing are yet to comment. No agreement was expected to follow the talks, an unnamed, senior American official said, according to news agencies AP and Reuters. Trump will arrive in Shenzhen late on Wednesday for the two-day summit between the 21 member states. He will also take part in bilateral talks with Xi on Thursday - their fourth meeting since the US president returned to office in 2025. "President Trump will conclude his visit to China with a trilateral meeting between the president of the United States, the president of the People's Republic of China, and the president of the Russian Federation," Wales said. She said Trump's trip, which will also include attending an Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) summit in the Philippines on Tuesday, would "secure historic wins to the American people and advance America's interests in the Indo Pacific". A nuclear weapons control treaty between the US and Russia expired in February, leaving the world's biggest nuclear arsenals without major guardrails and effectively marking an end to the arms control co-operation which helped to resolve the Cold War. The UN has urged both sides to agree a new framework without delay. Trump however said he could replace the deal with a better agreement which included China, which has been building up its arsenal. Former senior US officials and analysts told the BBC at the time that seeking Beijing and Moscow's co-operation could turn up major hurdles and take years. Xi separately hosted both Putin and Trump in Beijing just days apart earlier this year, while the US president welcomed his Chinese counterpart to Washington in September. Beijing has become a crucial trading partner for Moscow since it launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, which has isolated Russia and left it subject to Western sanctions. But a controversial US deal to import Russian diesel and the suspension of sanctions targeting the biggest buyers of Moscow's oil and gas - including China - heightened European concern about the Trump administration's softening towards the Kremlin last month. Trump and Xi have meanwhile sought to project warmer ties at summits in Beijing and Washington this year - though little significant progress appeared to have been made on key issues such as trade, their race for AI dominance, and Taiwan. The war in Iran has also been a sticking point, with Beijing the largest buyer of Tehran's oil and its biggest trade partner. Chinese state media reported on Friday that Xi would take part in "bilateral" talks on the sidelines of the Apec summit, citing a foreign ministry spokesman, but has not reported on the trilateral meeting. Earlier this month, Russian state news agency Tass reported that Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov had said there were "signals confirming readiness" for such talks at the summit. - Published20 May - Published19 May

news.articleText: ABD'de hava trafiği neden durdu? 4 soruda büyük uçuş krizi ABD'de hava trafik kontrol sistemlerinde yaşanan teknik arıza nedeniyle ülke genelinde uçuşlar dört saatten fazla durduruldu. 10 binden fazla uçuşun aksadığı kriz sonrası gecikme ve iptallerin hafta sonu da sürmesi bekleniyor. İşte 4 soruda ABD'deki uçuş krizinin nedenleri ve son durum. ABD'de 11 Eylül 2001 saldırılarından bu yana ikinci kez ülke genelinde uçuş kalkışları durduruldu. Hava trafik kontrol sistemlerinde yaşanan teknik arıza nedeniyle 10 binden fazla uçuş aksarken, yüz binlerce yolcunun seyahat planı altüst oldu. Uçuşlar yeniden başlasa da gecikme ve iptallerin hafta sonu boyunca devam etmesi bekleniyor. İşte ABD'deki hava ulaşımı krizine ilişkin merak edilenler... 1. ABD'de uçuşlar neden durduruldu? ABD Federal Havacılık İdaresi (FAA), birden fazla hava trafik kontrol merkezini etkileyen telekomünikasyon sorunları nedeniyle cuma günü ülke genelinde uçuş kalkışlarını durdurdu. ABD Ulaştırma Bakanı Sean Duffy, hava trafik kontrol sistemlerinde kullanılan telekomünikasyon yönlendiricilerinin aşırı veri yükü nedeniyle çöktüğünü açıkladı. Arızanın, uçakların yüksek irtifalarda rotaları boyunca yönlendirilmesini sağlayan merkezleri etkilediği belirtildi. FAA, güvenlik açısından tedbirli davranarak uçuşları durdurma kararı alırken, krizin temel nedenlerinden biri olarak ABD'nin eskiyen havacılık teknolojisi gösterildi. 2. Kaç uçuş ve yolcu etkilendi? Ülke genelinde dört saatten fazla süren uçuş durdurma kararı nedeniyle 10 binden fazla uçuş aksadı. Uçuş verileri şirketi Cirium'a göre, cuma günü ABD'nin doğu saatiyle 16.00'dan sonra ülkedeki havalimanlarından yaklaşık 11 bin uçuşun kalkması planlanıyordu. Bu uçuşlarda toplam 1,5 milyon yolcunun seyahat etmesi öngörülüyordu. Cirium ayrıca yaklaşık 600 uçuşun rotasında değişiklik yapıldığını, bunlardan 104'ünün farklı havalimanlarına yönlendirildiğini bildirdi. Havalimanlarında yoğunluk yaşanırken, uçakların park edileceği alanların bulunmasında da güçlük çekildi. 3. Uçuşlar yeniden başladı mı, gecikmeler ne zaman bitecek? FAA, ülke genelindeki uçuş durdurma kararını cuma günü ABD'nin doğu saatiyle 20.15'te (Türkiye saatiyle cumartesi 04.15) kaldırdı. Ancak uçuşların yeniden başlamasıyla birlikte havalimanlarındaki yoğunluk sona ermedi. Uçuş ekiplerinin günlük çalışma sürelerinin dolması, uçakların planlanan noktalara ulaşamaması ve biriken seferler nedeniyle gecikme ve iptallerin hafta sonuna, hatta daha uzun bir süreye yayılması bekleniyor. CNBC'nin ulaştığı bir şirket içi nota göre JetBlue Airways, Avrupa rotaları dışındaki cuma günü kalan uçuşlarını ve cumartesi günü planlanan bazı seferlerini iptal etme kararı aldı. 4. Siber saldırı mı, eskiyen teknoloji mi? Kriz yeniden yaşanabilir mi? ABD İç Güvenlik Bakanı Markwayne Mullin, yaşanan sorunun ülkeye yönelik bir tehdit oluşturduğuna ilişkin herhangi bir işaret bulunmadığını açıkladı. Mullin, olayın siber saldırıdan ziyade teknik bir arızadan kaynaklanmış gibi göründüğünü belirtti. ABD'de hava trafik kontrol sistemlerinin eskiyen altyapısı ve personel eksikliği uzun süredir tartışılıyor. Eylül ayında bir fiber optik kablonun yanlışlıkla kesilmesi yüzlerce uçuşu aksatırken, 2025 yılında Newark Liberty Uluslararası Havalimanı'nda yaşanan ekipman arızası da ciddi gecikmelere neden olmuştu. Ulaştırma Bakanı Duffy, mevcut altyapının arızalanmaya devam edeceği uyarısında bulunarak Kongre'den modernizasyon çalışmaları için daha fazla finansman talep etti. FAA teknisyenlerinin ise son arızaya ilişkin incelemeleri sürüyor.

news.title: What we know about the longest ground stop since 9/11
news.summary: US officials say the disruption was caused by old equipment overloading and not a cyber-attack or a Microsoft outage.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: What we know about the longest ground stop since 9/11
news.summaryTr: US officials say the disruption was caused by old equipment overloading and not a cyber-attack or a Microsoft outage.
news.articleText: What we know about the longest US nationwide flight ground stop since 9/11 - Published The US Federal Aviation Administration has lifted the longest nationwide ground stop of flights since the 11 September 2001 terrorist attacks. The FAA said Friday's stoppage, which lasted more than four hours, was "due to extraordinary circumstances" from a communication issue affecting all air traffic control centres. Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said there was no indication of an attack and that everybody was safe. Here's what we know. How many flights were affected? The ground stop led to more than 8,500 delayed and nearly 8,000 cancelled flights on Friday, according to FlightAware. The FAA's initial announcement at 15:54 EST (20:54 GMT) said all flights departing within the US would be grounded until further notice. More than 3,500 airplanes were in the air at the time. Some were diverted to other airports and others flew on to their destinations. Hours later, some flights were allowed to take off from San Francisco International airport. The Federal Aviation Administration opened skies again at until 20:15 EST. What about international flights? All US-bound air traffic from Eurocontrol member states was suspended "on request of the FAA due to technical issues", according to Eurocontrol's website. There are 42 Eurocontrol member states, including dozens of EU nations, the UK, Ukraine, and Turkey, as well as Israel and Morocco. Australia's largest international airport, Sydney, grounded all US-bound flights until further notice. Air Canada cancelled flights between the US and Canada. When will normal service resume? Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said in a news conference on Friday night that the outage would cause a ripple effect for a few days. "It's going to take us some time to unwind what's happened this afternoon," Duffy said. Tens of thousands of people were stranded in airports around the country, many of them "without any knowledge of where they're going to sleep tonight", Duffy said. Delta Air Lines and United Airlines said they were resuming operations. American Airlines said it was "focused on operating as many remaining flights as possible this evening". JetBlue said it would resume flights on Saturday morning. What caused the ground stop? Duffy said a legacy air traffic control communications system became overloaded. "So this is analogue telecom. Our switches, our routers actually got overloaded with data and they went down," Duffy said. He said this had affected communications and radar. The system needs a complete overhaul, he said, estimating a $50 billion price tag. "It's going to continue to fail," he said. Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin told the news conference said they had seen "zero evidence" it was a cyber-attack. He also ruled out any link to the global Microsoft outage that began on Thursday. Mullin said the introduction of some new technology into an old air traffic control system had overwhelmed it. Both cabinet secretaries insisted the public was never in danger during the stoppage. When was the last ground stop? It was only the second such nationwide stoppage since the immediate aftermath of the al-Qaeda plane hijackings of 11 September 2001. "This looks like the worst since 9/11, but clearly not on that scale," Dr Guy Gratton, an associate professor of aviation at Cranfield University, told BBC Verify. Dr Gratton pointed to a US grounding in 2023 due to a failure in the Notice to Air Missions (Notam) system. "That lasted 1 hour and 52 minutes, delayed about 9,500 flights and cancelled about 1,300," he said. news.articleTextTr: What we know about the longest US nationwide flight ground stop since 9/11 - Published The US Federal Aviation Administration has lifted the longest nationwide ground stop of flights since the 11 September 2001 terrorist attacks. The FAA said Friday's stoppage, which lasted more than four hours, was "due to extraordinary circumstances" from a communication issue affecting all air traffic control centres. Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said there was no indication of an attack and that everybody was safe. Here's what we know. How many flights were affected? The ground stop led to more than 8,500 delayed and nearly 8,000 cancelled flights on Friday, according to FlightAware. The FAA's initial announcement at 15:54 EST (20:54 GMT) said all flights departing within the US would be grounded until further notice. More than 3,500 airplanes were in the air at the time. Some were diverted to other airports and others flew on to their destinations. Hours later, some flights were allowed to take off from San Francisco International airport. The Federal Aviation Administration opened skies again at until 20:15 EST. What about international flights? All US-bound air traffic from Eurocontrol member states was suspended "on request of the FAA due to technical issues", according to Eurocontrol's website. There are 42 Eurocontrol member states, including dozens of EU nations, the UK, Ukraine, and Turkey, as well as Israel and Morocco. Australia's largest international airport, Sydney, grounded all US-bound flights until further notice. Air Canada cancelled flights between the US and Canada. When will normal service resume? Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said in a news conference on Friday night that the outage would cause a ripple effect for a few days. "It's going to take us some time to unwind what's happened this afternoon," Duffy said. Tens of thousands of people were stranded in airports around the country, many of them "without any knowledge of where they're going to sleep tonight", Duffy said. Delta Air Lines and United Airlines said they were resuming operations. American Airlines said it was "focused on operating as many remaining flights as possible this evening". JetBlue said it would resume flights on Saturday morning. What caused the ground stop? Duffy said a legacy air traffic control communications system became overloaded. "So this is analogue telecom. Our switches, our routers actually got overloaded with data and they went down," Duffy said. He said this had affected communications and radar. The system needs a complete overhaul, he said, estimating a $50 billion price tag. "It's going to continue to fail," he said. Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin told the news conference said they had seen "zero evidence" it was a cyber-attack. He also ruled out any link to the global Microsoft outage that began on Thursday. Mullin said the introduction of some new technology into an old air traffic control system had overwhelmed it. Both cabinet secretaries insisted the public was never in danger during the stoppage. When was the last ground stop? It was only the second such nationwide stoppage since the immediate aftermath of the al-Qaeda plane hijackings of 11 September 2001. "This looks like the worst since 9/11, but clearly not on that scale," Dr Guy Gratton, an associate professor of aviation at Cranfield University, told BBC Verify. Dr Gratton pointed to a US grounding in 2023 due to a failure in the Notice to Air Missions (Notam) system. "That lasted 1 hour and 52 minutes, delayed about 9,500 flights and cancelled about 1,300," he said. The 2023 outage meant air traffic safety notices could no longer be published, and flights were grounded until that system was restored. But Friday's incident lasted longer than the 2023 event.
